validation.empty: Open a template's Upload dialog to see validation results for a file.

help.intro: The Data Exchange Center lets you download blank or example-filled templates, fill them in Excel or a spreadsheet tool, and safely bring the data back into FormuLab. Nothing is written until you have previewed the file and explicitly confirmed the import.
help.rowStates: Each row is classified before anything is written: a new record, an update to an existing one, unchanged, a duplicate within the file, a warning, an invalid row, or a missing reference. Only valid rows are imported by default — importing rows with issues requires explicitly choosing a partial import.
help.security: Every export neutralizes spreadsheet formulas so a file can never run code when opened in Excel; every import strips the same triggers back out. Files are checked for size and row-count limits before parsing.
help.authorization: Each template only accepts imports from specific roles, and some fields — verification status, approvals, reviewer sign-off — can never be set by an import, however the file is filled in. Those always require the normal, authorized workflow inside FormuLab.

addConnection.title: Add Connection
addConnection.fileDescription: Import structured files such as CSV, JSON, XML or XLSX.
addConnection.databaseDescription: Read data from an external relational database through the existing read-only connector.
addConnection.restDescription: Read structured data from a GET-only HTTP API.
addConnection.requireExplicitId: Require an explicit identity (never fall back to a staging-row position)
addConnection.databaseLimitation: No production database driver is wired in this build yet. This configuration is saved for a future connector — Test Connection will report this honestly rather than pretending to succeed.
addConnection.databaseDriverNotice: SQLite is the only production database driver supported in this build. It connects read-only directly to a local .sqlite/.db file — no host, port, or credentials are needed.
addConnection.sqliteFileHint: An absolute local file path — never a credential. Chosen via the native file picker, read-only.
addConnection.sqliteFileNone: No SQLite database file is configured yet — choose one first.
addConnection.databaseTableHint: Optional default table for this connection — Source Explorer can browse and pick any real table/view.
addConnection.connectionRefHint: An opaque reference — never a raw password, API key, or connection string. This build does not yet resolve it into REST authentication; REST requests are sent unauthenticated until a credential resolver is wired.
addConnection.getOnlyNotice: GET only — this connector can never write, update, delete, or patch the source.
addConnection.restAuthNotice: Authentication status: unauthenticated. This build does not yet resolve the connection reference into request credentials.
addConnection.paginationIncomplete: The selected pagination mode is missing required fields — Test and Save are disabled until it is complete.
addConnection.fileTestHint: Select a file in the Source Explorer to inspect it.

crosswalks.readOnlyNotice: Crosswalks are exact external-ID to canonical-ID identity bindings, created automatically after a successful import — never display-name matches, and never a manual edit action, since no safe mutation authority exists here. An ordinal (staging-row-position) identity is never persisted as a crosswalk.
